jobs.title: Senior SAP BRIM Analyst - Convergent Charging (CC)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled Sr. SAP BRIM Convergent Charging (CC) Analyst with 8\+ years of experience to support dynamic pricing and billing operations in a ride\-share / mobility ecosystem. The role focuses on designing and managing real\-time, usage\-based charging models for trips, driver incentives, commissions, and subscription offerings.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will...**
* Design and configure real\-time charging and rating solutions in SAP Convergent Charging for ride\-share use cases, supporting high\-volume, event\-driven processing (trip, GPS, and usage data).
* Implement complex pricing models including trip fares (base, time, distance), surge/dynamic pricing, cancellations, waiting charges, and driver commissions/platform fees.
* Configure discounts, promotions, referral credits, loyalty programs, and subscription models (e.g., ride passes, premium memberships).
* Integrate SAP CC with ride booking/trip systems, payment gateways/wallets, and SAP BRIM modules (CI, SOM, FI\-CA) to enable seamless end\-to\-end O2C processes.
* Monitor and optimize pricing performance, ensure accurate event rating (trip start/stop, distance/time, peak multipliers), and troubleshoot billing discrepancies and real\-time charging issues.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of SAP BRIM experience with strong specialization in SAP Convergent Charging, focusing on usage\-based and event\-driven charging models.
* Hands\-on expertise in real\-time rating, pricing configuration, and complex pricing logic (tiered, time\-based, geo\-based).
* Strong understanding of mobility/ride\-share pricing models, including distance/time billing, surge pricing, and commission structures.
* Experience working with high\-throughput transactional systems, APIs, event streaming, and real\-time data integrations.
* Solid knowledge of financial settlement flows, taxes, fees, and regional pricing/regulatory requirements.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA BRIM
* Familiarity with microservices architecture and cloud platforms (e.g., SAP BTP, AWS)
* Exposure to geo\-based pricing and location\-aware charging models


 $198,000 \- $237,000 a year
   

  

**Base Salary Range**
 There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.
   

  

 Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.
   

  

**About Zoox**
 Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team.
   

  

 Follow us on LinkedIn
   

  

**Accommodations**
 If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to \[email protected] or your assigned recruiter.
   

  

**A Final Note**
*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*
 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:

**Role Description:**



Own the strategy, roadmap, architecture, and delivery of the SAP S/4HANA Finance platform, with prima ry responsibility for Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Asset Accounting, Banking, and Financial Reporting. Partner with Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Engineering, and Enterprise Technology teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and efficient solutions. Serve as a senior product and solution leader who translates business priorities into technology outcomes while advancing AI\-enabled Finance capabilities.

  


#### **Responsibilities:**


* Own the SAP Finance product vision, roadmap, backlog, prioritization, and investment recommen dations across RTR and PTP.
* Lead requirements, process design, solution architecture, and delivery for SAP S/4HANA Finance, including GL, AP, Asset Accounting, Banking, financial close, reporting, and PTP capabilities.
* Design and support Asset Accounting processes, including asset acquisition, capitalization, transfers, retirement/disposal, depreciation, impairment, and integration with the General Ledger.
* Define current\- and future\-state architecture, identify portfolio gaps and overlaps, and establish scalable platform and integration strategies.
* Lead integrations between SAP and enterprise applications, including Thomson Reuters OneSource Tax, using APIs, middleware, data flows, extensions, and appropriate monitoring.
* Partner with GPOs, Finance leaders, Engineering, vendors, and implementation partners to drive delivery quality, issue resolution, governance, and operational stability.
* Lead agile delivery teams, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure effective testing, deployment, documentation, and support.
* Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities such as exception management, reconcilia tions, payment operations, Finance insights, and root\-cause analysis, with appropriate human review, controls, security, and auditability.
* Present roadmaps, solution options, risks, and investment proposals to executive stakeholders.
* Stay current on SAP, Finance, integration, automation, and SaaS transformation trends and champion best\-in\-class solutions.

  


**Requirements:**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience architecting and delivering SAP Finance solutions, including 5\+ years with SAP S/4HANA.
* Deep experience with SAP FI, including GL, AP, Asset Accounting, Banking, Financial Reporting, financial close, and RTR/PTP processes.
* Hands\-on experience with Asset Accounting configuration and end\-to\-end processes, including acquisition, capitalization, depreciation, transfers, retirement, impairment, and financial integration.
* Experience with Thomson Reuters OneSource Tax integration with SAP, including tax determination, transaction data flows, tax posting, field mappings, and issue resolution.
* Experience defining enterprise architecture, business capability maps, current\-to\-future\-state roadmaps, and integration strategies.
* Proven experience leading agile teams, managing product backlogs, partnering with business stake holders, and overseeing vendors or implementation partners.
* Strong executive communication, solution design, troubleshooting, governance, and Finance controls experience.
* Demonstrated ability to identify practical AI, automation, or data\-driven opportunities that improve Finance productivity and quality.

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* SAP Certification in Finance or a related SAP discipline.
* Experience with Accounts Receivable, SAP BRIM, FICA, Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), or subscription\-based Finance processes.
* Experience in high\-tech, SaaS, software, or Finance transformation programs.
* CPA, MBA, or equivalent Finance/accounting credential.
* Familiarity with SAP BTP, AI platforms, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agentic frameworks, or low\-code/no\-code development.
* Experience implementing responsible AI governance, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, or AI\-enabled Finance solutions

* Collaborate with internal business teams, implementation partners, and third\-party vendors.
* Support functional troubleshooting, requirements discussions, and SAP\-related inquiries throughout project phases.
* Work across multiple project workstreams to ensure successful solution delivery.

**Qualifications:**


* 10\+ years of SAP implementation experience.
* Experience in SAP FICA.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementations.
* Utility industry experience.
* Participation in at least two SAP implementation projects (Greenfield and/or Brownfield).
* Experience configuring and supporting billing and invoicing processes within SAP.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Are you someone who is passionate, motivated, and driven to make a difference? If so, MSA Safety is the perfect fit for your career.  

At MSA, SAFETY is who we are AND it is what we do. We are a purpose\-driven company committed to deploying innovation and technology to deliver on our Mission to help protect people and assets all around the world. We continue to be relentless in our pursuit of solving our customers greatest problems so they can go home safe each and every day.  

Are you in? Read on for more details about this particular role.
Responsibilities:
* Own end\-to\-end subscription\-to\-revenue solution architecture: run Fit\-to\-Standard / explore\-phase workshops, drive Key Design Decisions, and produce solution and RICEFW documentation aligned to SAP Activate methodology.
* Configure RAR on S/4HANA — revenue accounting contracts, performance obligations (POBs), BRFplus decision tables, account determination, and posting logic for point\-in\-time and over\-time recognition — as part of the ECC\-to\-S/4HANA conversion.
* Architect the SAP Subscription Billing solution (cloud, on SAP BTP): rate plans and pricing, subscription lifecycle, usage rating/metering, and bill creation for recurring, one\-time, usage/consumption\-based, and tiered models.
* Design the integration between SAP Subscription Billing and S/4HANA \- billing/invoice data flowing into Convergent Invoicing (FI\-CA) and/or SD billing, and onward into RAR — using SAP Integration Suite / API\-based (iFlow) patterns; define the BTP integration and data architecture.
* Lead fit\-gap analysis on complex subscription and revenue scenarios — multi\-element/bundled software\-plus\-service deals, ramp deals, mid\-term upgrades/downgrades and proration, cancellations and credits, usage overages, and contract modifications under ASC 606\.
* Design the inflight\-contract transition and initial\-load strategy; define the migration approach for revenue data moving off ECC, and the onboarding/migration approach for active subscriptions into SAP Subscription Billing.
* Ensure RAR sub\-ledger reconciliation with FI\-GL and COPA, and reconciliation between Subscription Billing, invoicing (CI/FI\-CA), and revenue; validate G/L postings with accounting teams and support disclosure and reporting needs.
* Direct integration, regression, and UAT testing across the S/4HANA and BTP landscape; lead cutover, go\-live, and hypercare, including high\-volume order, subscription, and usage\-data conversion validation.
* Own the solution post\-go\-live: lead support, period\-close and billing\-cycle support, enhancements, and SAP release/upgrade impact assessments (including the cloud release cadence of Subscription Billing), and maintain solution documentation and governance.
* Manage and direct system integrator (SI) resources, coordinate with internal functional/configuration teams, and partner with internal audit, external auditors, and controllership on ongoing compliance and revenue policy changes.


Qualifications:
* Hands\-on SAP RAR configuration experience across full\-lifecycle implementations and/or ECC\-to\-S/4HANA conversions; relevant SAP certifications (RAR, SD/FI) preferred.
* Experience implementing or integrating SAP Subscription Billing (the standalone cloud product on BTP), including rate plans, usage rating, and the S/4HANA integration pattern; familiarity with Convergent Invoicing (FI\-CA) as the landing point is an asset.
* Deep IFRS 15 / ASC 606 revenue recognition expertise as applied to subscription and multi\-element arrangements, including transition and initial\-load strategies.
* Strong command of BRFplus, ARL, and RAI\-based integration between billing and RAR.
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration / iFlows, APIs) for cloud\-to\-S/4HANA integration.
* Proven OTC/QTC and order/subscription\-management architecture experience (pricing, account determination, Fiori) feeding billing and revenue.
* Preferred experience with SAP ECC to S/4 HANA migration or full life cycle S/4 HANA Implementation and support.
* Fluency in SAP Activate deliverables by phase and in cutover discipline (freeze windows, mock cycles, reconciliation gates, go/no\-go).
* RAR / event\-based revenue recognition exposure for subscriptions.
* Familiarity with S/4HANA Private Cloud (RISE) deployment and SAP Activate; FI\-GL and COPA integration knowledge.
* Demonstrated ability to lead internal teams and SI partners, and to bridge technical and accounting/business audiences.

**Education and experience required:**  

This position is available at three different career levels based upon experience:

* **Level I**: 2 years IT or related business process experience
* **Level II**: 3 years IT or related business process experience and 2 years SAP configuration experience in the SD modules
* **Level III**: 5 years IT or related Sales and Distribution business process experience and 5 years SAP configuration experience in SD modules

**Preferred:*** Bachelor’s Degree in Information Science, Computer Science, or related discipline.

We are hiring a senior SAP Convergent Charging (CC) specialist to lead a two\-step version upgrade from CC 2021 to CC 2025, followed by migration of the upgraded landscape into a RISE with SAP (SAP\-managed, ECS) environment.

Two\-step CC upgrade (2021 2023* 2025\) executed on\-premise, with functional and rating validation at each step
* Remediation of custom charging plans, mapping tables, and user\-defined functions across both hops
* Component\-level upgrade across Core Server, Dispatcher, Updater, BART, Diameter/HTTP interfaces, and Admin/Core Tool
* Database, SAP JVM, and OS prerequisite alignment for each target release
* Migration of the upgraded landscape to RISE (ECS) via tenant copy, including connectivity, cutover, and hypercare
* Regression of integration to Convergent Invoicing / FI\-CA, mediation, and CRM/subscription order management

  

**Key Responsibilities**
  

  

**Upgrade execution**
* Build the upgrade path and prerequisite matrix using Maintenance Planner; confirm target stack, DB, and JVM compatibility per hop

Execute upgrades across DEV QA* PRD using SUM/SL Toolset; document runbooks and rollback plans
* Identify deprecated or changed CC APIs, charging plan constructs, and configuration objects between releases and drive remediation
* Own downtime planning for session\-based charging (Diameter) and prepaid balance handling

**RISE migration**
* Define the target CC deployment model within ECS and confirm the shared\-responsibility split with SAP for CC components
* Plan and execute the tenant copy, including master data, charging plan export/import, and bulk loader\-driven reload
* Establish connectivity to on\-prem and third\-party systems (Cloud Connector, VPN/private link, network zones, certificates)
* Coordinate SAP ECS activities through the agreed governance model (SAP Cloud ALM, service requests, cutover windows)
  

  

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years in SAP BRIM, with 4\+ years hands\-on in SAP Convergent Charging specifically (not CI/FI\-CA\-only experience)
* Delivered at least one CC version upgrade end\-to\-end, including prerequisite analysis, execution, and post\-upgrade validation
* Deep working knowledge of CC architecture: Core Server, Dispatcher, Updater, BART, Diameter and HTTP interfaces, and the CC administration tooling
* Practical experience building and troubleshooting charging plans, charged item classes, mapping tables, and user\-defined functions
* Comfortable at the OS and Java layer: SAP JVM, CC instance configuration, log analysis, performance tuning
* Experience with SAP HANA (or ASE) as the CC database, including sizing and upgrade prerequisites
* Proven integration experience with Convergent Invoicing and FI\-CA in S/4HANA or ERP
* Able to write and execute a cutover plan for a high\-volume, revenue\-critical system

**Preferred**


* Prior RISE with SAP / ECS migration experience, including tenant copy and working within the SAP shared\-responsibility model
* Experience with SAP Convergent Mediation (DigitalRoute) or comparable mediation platforms
* SAP Cloud ALM, Solution Manager, or equivalent test and cutover tooling

**CHALLENGE**
* Generate and process invoices accurately and efficiently for products and services provided to clients to ensure timely revenue generation
* Manage and oversee the end\-to\-end resolution of customer claims and billing disputes (within the SAP BRIM system) to enhance customer trust and contribute to positive client experiences
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Service, and other relevant departments to understand the nature of customer claims and identify root causes of billing discrepancies
* Implement proactive strategies to prevent recurring billing issues and disputes, working towards a sustainable solution
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of customer claims, resolutions, and communication in compliance with company policies to ensure transparency, compliance, and the ability to learn from past resolutions
* Act as the main point of contact for customers regarding billing disputes, providing exceptional customer service and ensuring timely and satisfactory issue resolution
* Analyze trends and patterns in customer claims to identify systemic problems and recommend process improvements
* Prepare comprehensive reports and presentations on customer claims, resolutions, and improvement initiatives for management review
* Provide training and guidance to internal teams on proper billing practices, dispute resolution procedures, and SAP BRIM functionalities to enhance team capabilities and reducing errors

* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail

* Customer\-oriented mindset with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders

* Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

 FirstEnergy at a Glance
   

  

 We are a forward\-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.
   

  

 FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to safety, reliability and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor\-owned electric systems, more than 24,500 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid\-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of 3,780 megawatts.
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 This is an open position with FirstEnergy Service Co., a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 FirstEnergy is seeking an SAP Developer to support our SAP platform, with primary responsibility for Billing and Customer Choice solutions. This role is responsible for the design, development, enhancement, testing, implementation, and support of SAP processes that enable critical utility customer billing and competitive market operations.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Develop, maintain, and enhance SAP solutions supporting utility billing and deregulated market operations.
* Partner with business clients and functional teams to analyze business requirements and translate them into effective technical specifications and solutions.
* Design, develop, and support SAP programs, reports, interfaces, workflows, enhancements, and integrations.
* Develop solutions that adhere to established development standards, security requirements, and best practices.
* Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve application defects and production issues.
* Develop and execute unit test plans and support user acceptance testing activities.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation for implemented solutions and support procedures.
* Provide day\-to\-day production support, including incident resolution, root cause analysis, and operational monitoring.
* Support customer nightly batch processing, including occasional after\-hours support activities as needed.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
* SAP ABAP development experience.
* Working knowledge of SAP development lifecycle processes, transports, and production support activities.
* Demonstrated aptitude for software development and technical problem solving.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
* Strong commitment to customer service, continuous learning, and process improvement.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SAP IS\-U experience, particularly within Billing, Invoicing, FICA, or Deregulation/Customer Choice processes.
* Understanding of utility billing processes and competitive retail energy markets.
* Experience supporting enterprise production applications and participating in on\-call support rotations.
* Knowledge or willingness to learn SAP IDOC Processing, EDI Transactions, and Batch Processing for supporting Customer
* Knowledge of Data Dictionary, Workflow, ABAP Objects, and performance improvement.

 At FirstEnergy, employees are key to our success. We depend on their talents to meet the challenges of our changing business environment. Please visit our website at www.firstenergycorp.com to learn more about all of our employee rewards programs. FirstEnergy proudly supports workforce diversity. jobs.title: Senior Consultant - SAP BRIM CC
jobs.description:
Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP\-enabled solutions.
   

  

 Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026\.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant on the SAP team, you will support clients across the solution lifecycle, from business process assessment through design, build, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live activities.
   

  

* Deliver SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) Convergent Charging (CC) solutions that support monetization, pricing, rating, charging, and revenue management transformation
* Assess business requirements, evaluate current\-state lead\-to\-cash, usage\-to\-bill, and subscription\-to\-bill processes, and design future\-state SAP BRIM solutions
* Configure SAP BRIM CC across key functional areas such as charging plans, charge plans, charging contracts, mapping tables, pricing logic, rating, discounting, allowance and recurring fee models, and consumption\-based charging scenarios
* Support design and configuration for mediation and usage processing, including event data handling, chargeable item creation, and integration with upstream and downstream BRIM components
* Support integration design and issue resolution across SAP CC and adjacent SAP solutions, including Convergent Invoicing (CI), Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA), Subscription Order Management (SOM), Sales and Distribution (SD), Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), and SAP S/4HANA Finance
* Facilitate workshops with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, align on solution design, and support fit\-to\-standard decision\-making
* Prepare functional specifications and support development, testing, defect triage, cutover, deployment, and stabilization activities across the implementation lifecycle


 A successful candidate would possess these skills:
   

  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others


**The team**
 Deloitte's SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP\-enabled transformations across core business functions. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first\-time implementations, business\-led enhancements, and large\-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.
   

  

 Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Bachelor's degree or Associate's degree plus 6\+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), billing, charging, revenue management, or consulting experience
* 5\+ years of SAP consulting experience supporting solution design and end\-to\-end delivery in a consulting firm, industry environment, or both
* 2\+ years of experience with SAP BRIM Convergent Charging, configuring rating and charging processes.
* Participation in 2\+ full lifecycle SAP BRIM implementations involving mediation, billing, charging, or usage\-to\-cash processes
* Experience supporting integration with Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing, Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, Subscription Order Management, Sales and Distribution, Revenue Accounting and Reporting, or SAP S/4HANA Finance
* Experience with rate design, pricing configuration, discounts, balance management, or allowance configuration in SAP BRIM Convergent Charging
* Experience with 1\+ SAP S/4HANA implementation, transformation, or migration program
* Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve


**Preferred**
* Master's degree
* 2\+ years of client service delivery experience in a consulting or professional services firm supporting large enterprise transformation engagements
* Experience leading design workshops and Phase 0 Discovery workshops in the Usage to Cash process area
* Experience leading a team of individuals across the Subscription To Cash process area across different locations.
* Current SAP certification in SAP Convergent Charging


 The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300\.
   

  

 You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

* Work on Middleware design \& configuration between BRIM modules, SAP \& Non\-SAP systems managing internal \& external system integrations.

**Flexible Consumption Billing Implementation Manager**  

  

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on October 31, 2026  

  

**Work You'll Do**  

  

As a Manager, Flexible Consumption Billing Implementation, you will be responsible for:  

* Working on integrated project teams on a range of projects covering the entire lifecycle from strategy formulation through to design, development and the deployment of solutions.
* Bringing considerable billing management expertise to help design, develop and implement subscription billing solutions to transform client's billing processes.
* Interacting daily with key business and IT executives
* Leading multiple teams in various strategy and implementation activities.
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues
* Determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches
* Evaluating and validate analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Implementing and overseeing the quality of deliverables and effectively manage the team and day\-to\-day relationships to ensure exceptional performance.

  

The successful Manager you will possess:  

* Strong communication skills \- ability to communicate complex system concepts to a business audience in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to facilitate clients' most complex business requirements
* Knowledge of basic accounting policies, and implications
* Experience identifying creative solutions within configurable cloud systems or within boundary applications where customization is required
* Leadership \- proven ability to lead complex engagements, both business and technical, including multiple dependencies and integration points
* Problem solving and troubleshooting skills with the ability to exercise mature judgment

  

**The Team**  

  

Our Sales \& Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:
  

* 5\+ years experience in subscription billing within consulting or industry, specifically focused on delivering cloud\-based subscription billing solutions
* 5\+ years experience with end\-to\-end implementations of Subscription Billing solutions (e.g. Zuora Billing, Oracle NetSuite, SAP BRIM)
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
* A Bachelor's degree

  

Preferred:
  

* Minimum 4 years of experience designing or optimizing lead\-to\-cash and record\-to\-report processes and end\-to\-end architectures.
* 4\+ years of direct experience across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), including Design, Build, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Support.
* 4\+ years of practical experience applying Agile and Scrum methodologies to deliver technology or business solutions.
* 4\+ years of experience conducting architecture assessments and developing implementation roadmaps for subscription billing solutions.
* 4\+ years of experience designing and configuring cloud or SaaS\-based billing solutions in complex, multi\-entity environments.
* 3\+ years of experience designing integrations with upstream systems (such as Ordering, Provisioning) and downstream ERP applications (such as General Ledger)
* Minimum 1 year of experience managing teams of 5 or more people, including responsibility for performance, deliverables, and team development.

  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $ 134,500 \- $265,100\.  

  

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.description:
Data\-Core Systems, Inc. is a provider of information technology, consulting, and business process services. We offer breakthrough tech solutions and have worked with companies, hospitals, universities, and government organizations. A proven partner with a passion for client satisfaction, we combine technology innovation, business process expertise, and a global, collaborative workforce that exemplifies the future of work. For more information about Data\-Core Systems, Inc., please visit https://datacoresystems.com/.

  

Our client is a roadway system, and as a part of their digital transformation, they are implementing a solution based on SAP BRIM \& Microsoft Dynamics CE.

  

Data\-Core Systems Inc. is seeking a **SAP Functional BRIM Specialist \- FICA (Contract Accounts Receivable \& Payable)** to be a part of our Consulting team. You will participate and effectively contribute to the design, development, and implementation of complex applications, often using new technologies. You will provide technical expertise and systems design for individual initiatives. You will have the opportunity to work with other SME consultants from our existing team.

 **Roles \& Responsibilities:**


* Configure and support SAP FICA processes including payments, dunning, collections, interest, and open item management.
* Design and deliver functional solutions for billing and financial integration with Convergent Invoicing (CI) and General Ledger (GL).
* Gather and document business requirements; translate into functional specifications and system designs.
* Support end\-to\-end Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) processes and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Collaborate with technical teams on enhancements, integrations, and BRF\+ rules.
* Support data migration activities including mapping, conversion, and validation of financial data.
* Develop and execute test cases; support SIT and UAT and resolve defects.
* Provide post\-go\-live support including monitoring payments, dunning runs, and batch jobs.
* Ensure compliance with financial controls, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Create and maintain documentation including functional designs, test scripts, and process procedures.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including billing, finance, CRM, and integration teams.

  


**Required Skills \& Experience:**


* 3\-7\+ years of SAP BRIM experience with a strong focus on FI\-CA.
* At least one full\-cycle SAP S/4HANA BRIM implementation.
* Hands\-on experience with FICA processes: payments, dunning, collections, and account management.
* Experience integrating FICA with Convergent Invoicing (CI) and SAP Finance (GL).
* Experience supporting high\-volume transaction environments.
* Familiarity with data migration, testing (SIT/UAT), and production support.
* Experience with ALM tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO) or JIRA.

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience with BRF\+, event framework, and correspondence configuration.
* Experience with financial integrations (lockbox, ACH, bank statements, payment gateways).
* Experience in utilities, tolling, telecommunications, or other usage\-based billing environments.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow and ITIL/ITSM practices.

  


**Required Education and Certifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* SAP S/4HANA BRIM or FICA certifications preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

  



We are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: SAP SD Consultant
jobs.description:
Our
 **Consulting** 
 team at BearingPoint is dedicated to optimizing client business operations through advanced ERP and CRM systems. With deep expertise in SAP across various domains like finance, logistics, data, and technology, we streamline processes and enhance decision\-making efficiency. Our proficiency in Salesforce helps us improve customer relationships with innovative strategies. We leverage data tools like PowerBI for insightful analytics and excel in Microsoft cloud technologies, particularly Azure, to provide secure and scalable solutions. Additionally, our team develops integrated mobile front\-end and back\-end applications, ensuring user\-friendly mobile access to ERP and CRM systems.
   

  

 BearingPoint's consulting services are designed to deliver tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of each client, driving growth and operational excellence. We pride ourselves on our client\-centric approach, focusing on delivering measurable results and sustainable improvements.
   

  

**Location:** 
**Bangalore/Hybrid**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced SAP SD Functional Consultant to join a large\-scale SAP S/4HANA implementation program in India. In this role, the focus is on the Sales \& Distribution workstream — with particular emphasis on pricing configuration, billing document management, and the integration of SD billing outputs with SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI) and FI\-CA. The ideal candidate understands how SD fits into the broader Order\-to\-Cash and Consume\-to\-Cash process chains, and can configure and deliver SD solutions that align with subscription\-based and service\-oriented business models
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure SAP SD processes scoped to subscription and service\-based sales — including sales order types, item categories, schedule lines, and copy control relevant to BRIM subscription order flows
* Design and configure pricing procedures and condition techniques to support one\-time, recurring, and usage\-based charge scenarios aligned with BRIM billing outputs from SAP Convergent Charging
* Configure and manage SD billing documents, billing plans, and output determination to ensure accurate handoff of billing data to SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI) for consolidated invoice creation
* Set up and validate SD\-to\-FI\-CA integration settings, including posting rules for customer account groups, transfer settings to invoicing, and derivation of main/sub\-transactions from SD billing document data
* Configure integration between SD Billing and SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI), including assignment of CI subprocesses to SD document types, AIF settings, and mass activity configuration for transferring CI billing documents to SD Billing
* Participate in solution design workshops to define SD configuration aligned with BRIM data model objects — including business partners, contract accounts, provider contracts, and billing plans
* Prepare and maintain functional specifications, configuration workbooks, and integration design documents covering SD\-BRIM touchpoints
* Develop and execute test scripts for unit testing, integration testing, and UAT — with a focus on end\-to\-end billing flows from subscription order through to invoice generation
* Support data migration activities for SD\-relevant master data including customer masters, pricing condition records, and billing output condition types
* Provide hypercare and post\-go\-live support, resolving production incidents related to SD pricing, billing, and CI integration


**Required Skills**
* 4–7 years of hands\-on SAP SD functional experience, including at least one full\-cycle S/4HANA implementation — ideally in a BRIM or subscription billing context
* Strong configuration skills in SD pricing and billing: pricing procedures, condition types, access sequences, billing document types, billing plans, and output/condition\-based output management
* Solid understanding of SD\-to\-FI\-CA integration: posting to FI\-CA for customer account groups, transfer to invoicing settings, and derivation of controlling values from SD billing documents
* Working knowledge of SD\-to\-Convergent Invoicing (CI) integration: CI subprocess assignment to SD document types, distributed CI/SD system settings, and AIF configuration
* Familiarity with the BRIM data model — including subscription orders, provider contracts, contract accounts, charge plans, and billable items — and how SD fits within the end\-to\-end BRIM process chain
* Ability to write clear and detailed functional specifications for ABAP developments, BAdIs, and enhancements related to SD pricing and billing
* Experience conducting business workshops, gathering requirements, and translating them into SD configuration and solution design

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Our **Consulting** team at BearingPoint is dedicated to optimizing client business operations through advanced ERP and CRM systems. With deep expertise in SAP across various domains like finance, logistics, data, and technology, we streamline processes and enhance decision\-making efficiency. Our proficiency in Salesforce helps us improve customer relationships with innovative strategies. We leverage data tools like PowerBI for insightful analytics and excel in Microsoft cloud technologies, particularly Azure, to provide secure and scalable solutions. Additionally, our team develops integrated mobile front\-end and back\-end applications, ensuring user\-friendly mobile access to ERP and CRM systems.


BearingPoint's consulting services are designed to deliver tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of each client, driving growth and operational excellence. We pride ourselves on our client\-centric approach, focusing on delivering measurable results and sustainable improvements.


We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) Functional Consultant to join our growing SAP practice in India. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on expertise in the end\-to\-end Usage\-to\-Cash process, covering Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing, and FI\-CA, with a strong ability to translate complex business billing requirements into scalable SAP solutions.

 **Primary Functions and Tasks:**

* Design, configure, and implement SAP BRIM components including **Convergent Charging (CC)**, **Convergent Invoicing (CI)**, and **Financial Contract Accounting (FI\-CA)**
* Model pricing and rating scenarios, including charge plans, price plans, and charging plans within SAP Convergent Charging
* Manage contract accounting structures and execute invoicing processes within an integrated BRIM architecture
* Configure billable item management, provider contracts, and subscription order management
* Support integration of SAP BRIM with **SAP S/4HANA**, SAP CRM, and SAP ERP landscapes
* Participate in business blueprint workshops, requirement gathering, and solution design sessions
* Prepare functional specifications, configuration documentation, and test scripts
* Collaborate with technical developers to deliver BRIM enhancements and custom solutions
* Support UAT, go\-live, and post\-production stabilization activities
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to knowledge\-sharing within the team

**We are looking for:**

* Minimum **5 years of hands\-on SAP BRIM experience** with at least 2 full\-cycle implementations
* Strong expertise in **SAP Convergent Charging** – charge plans, price plans, rate plans, allowances, and rating logic
* Proficiency in **SAP Convergent Invoicing** – billable items, invoicing roles (Invoicing Specialist, Invoicing Admin), and revenue sharing/partner settlement
* Solid knowledge of **FI\-CA** – contract accounts, business partners, posting areas, dunning, and collections
* Experience with BRIM integration with **SAP S/4HANA** or SAP ERP
* Strong understanding of subscription\-based and usage\-based billing business processes
* Good documentation skills – functional specs, business blueprints, and test documentation
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* SAP BRIM certification is preferred

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with **SAP Subscription Order Management (SOM)** or **SAP Entitlement Management**
* Exposure to **SAP BTP** integration scenarios with BRIM
* Industry background in Telecom, Utilities, Media, or High\-Tech/SaaS
* Familiarity with **SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)**
* Knowledge of **Open APIs and Interfaces** within the BRIM landscape

**What we offer:**

* Learning\-oriented organization with a people development focus
* Attractive compensation package:
* Fixed salary compensation along with Yearly Evaluation and performance\-related bonus scheme
* Benefits buffet
* Extended annual leave
* Complete training \& certification curricula available
* E\-Learning System

**For more information, please visit:** www.linkedin.com/company/bearingpoint

**About BearingPoint**


BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. The company operates in three business units: Consulting, Products, and Capital. Consulting covers the advisory business with a clear focus on selected business areas. Products provides IP\-driven digital assets and managed services for business\-critical processes. Capital delivers M\&A and transaction services.


BearingPoint’s clients include many of the world’s leading companies and organizations. The firm has a global consulting network with more than 10,000 people and supports clients in over 70 countries, engaging with them to achieve measurable and sustainable success.

*BearingPoint is a certified B Corporation, meeting* high standards of social and environmental impact.

*In India, BearingPoint currently* operates with one office situated in Bengaluru. We work closely with all BearingPoint entities and offer technology and management consulting services with a human touch to both local and international top clients. We also enable our Products unit with development and Platform services SAP.

*Our team in India allows us to* leverage work with clients who have extensive operations and affiliations in various European countries, in the US, and across Asia.

*Together with our colleagues from Romania, the Czech Republic, and Portugal, we are part of BearingPoint’s Cross\-Shore Enablement Hub (CSH) which offers a wide range of Consulting and Products* expertise.

jobs.description:

*Benefits \- Avangrid*
**Job Summary**
 The Sr. Manager, Customer Service Technology Billing \& Collections is responsible for Billing, FICA \& Collections Technology. Position is also responsible for the day\-to\-day management, delivery, and operational performance of technology platforms supporting Billing, Financial Contract Accounting (FICA), and Credit \& Collections functions for a regulated electric and/or gas utility.
   

  

 The Sr. Manager, Customer Service Billing \& Collections role serves as the primary IT partner to Billing Operations, Credit \& Collections, Revenue Protection, and Customer Accounting teams, ensuring systems are stable, compliant, and responsive to changing operational and regulatory requirements. The incumbent will play a key role in maintaining billing accuracy, reducing exceptions, supporting revenue assurance, and enabling customer focused collections practices through effective use of technology.
   

  

 The Sr. Manager, IT Customer Service Technology role reports into the Director – IT Applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Ownership – Billing, FI‑CA \& Collections**
* Own the technology platforms and configurations supporting:
* Consumption and non‑consumption billing
* FICA contract accounts, postings, payments, and dunning
* Credit and collections workflows, rules, and customer communications
* Ensure systems operate reliably during critical billing, invoicing, and collections cycles.
* Act as first‑line IT accountability for production issues impacting bills, payments, or customer balances.


**Operational Stability \& Exception Management**
* Monitor system performance, batch jobs, interfaces, and controls across the billing and collections landscape.
* Partner with business teams to identify, prioritize, and reduce billing exceptions, estimated bills, and manual workarounds.
* Lead root‑cause analysis and corrective actions for billing defects, posting issues, and collections failures.


**Delivery \& Continuous Improvement**
* Lead IT delivery for billing and collections enhancements, including configuration changes, releases, and minor projects.
* Translate business requirements into clear functional and technical designs aligned with utility standards.
* Support testing activities (unit, integration, UAT) with strong emphasis on bill accuracy and customer impact.


**Regulatory \& Compliance Support**
* Ensure billing and collections technology complies with applicable tariffs, customer protection rules, and regulatory timelines.
* Support internal and external audits, data requests, and regulatory inquiries related to billing accuracy and collections practices.
* Maintain appropriate controls, documentation, and traceability for changes impacting customer charges and financial outcomes.


**Business Partnership \& Coordination**
* Serve as a day‑to‑day IT liaison for Billing, Credit \& Collections, and Customer Accounting leadership.
* Coordinate across IT teams (CIS, integrations, data, infrastructure) to resolve issues and deliver enhancements.
* Communicate clearly with business partners on system issues, risks, release timing, and stabilization activities.


**Vendor \& Team Management**
* Manage small teams of analysts/configurators and coordinate work with system integrators or application support vendors.
* Ensure SLAs, backlog priorities, and release activities align with billing calendars and operational constraints.
* Contribute to planning and forecasting of run‑costs and small capital initiatives within assigned scope.


**Leadership**
* High attention to detail and accountability for customer impacting outcomes
* Calm, structured response to production issues
* Strong collaboration with business operations
* Risk\-aware mindset appropriate for regulated environments
* Continuous improvement orientation


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field of study and a minimum of ten (10\) years of relevant experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* Relevant experience includes progressively responsible experience in IT, with significant focus on customer‑facing or customer‑operations technology.
* Demonstrated experience with customer information systems (CIS), SAP IS\-U FI\-CA \& Billing or other large‑scale customer service platforms.
* Proven ability to lead cross‑functional delivery teams and manage complex, high‑visibility systems.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field of study.
* Hands on experience with CIS billing, IS\-U FI CA, or credit and collections platforms.
* Understanding of batch processing, billing cycles, and customer impact of system changes.
* Experience with FICA concepts such as contract accounts, dunning, write offs, agency interfaces, and payment processing.
* Familiarity with utility credit and collections policies, including low\-income programs, payment arrangements, and regulatory constraints.
* Ability to balance operational stability with incremental modernization.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly when explaining system issues to non technical stakeholders.


**Competencies**
* Growth \& Continuous Improvement
* Initiative \& Change
* Focused on Results
* Customer Centric (internal and/or extern

**Job Summary**
 The Senior Manager \- SAP Architecture \& Solutions leads the design, integration, and governance of end\-to\-end SAP landscapes that align with business objectives and enterprise architecture standards. This role partners with business and IT stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, secure, and high\-performance SAP solutions across utilities processes (e.g., Meter\-to\-Cash, Billing, Device Management, FICA), and steers modernization initiatives including migrations to S/4HANA and adoption of SAP BTP.
   

  

 The Senior Manager \- SAP Architecture \& Solutions is also responsible for leading architectural reviews, fostering collaboration with key stakeholders, and ensuring alignment with the latest SAP innovations. This role focuses on optimizing system performance, enabling seamless integration, and maintaining a future\-ready SAP landscape that supports business agility and operational excellence.
   

  

 The Senior Manager \- SAP Architecture \& Solutions reports into the Director, IT Applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Owns the SAP solution architecture across IS\-U, Billing, Device Management, Energy Data Management (EDM), AMI, and FI\-CA; defines standards, patterns, and blueprints to ensure consistency and quality.
* Designs end\-to\-end SAP landscapes for on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments; leads modernization to S/4HANA and leverage SAP BTP services for integration and extensibility.
* Provides technical leadership across projects, upgrades, migrations, and integrations; ensures performance, reliability, and security across the SAP estate.
* Conducts architecture assessments, roadmaps, and reviews; identifies technical debt and opportunities to optimize cost, performance, and resilience.
* Evaluates emerging SAP technologies, tools, and vendor offerings; contributes to TCO analyses, RFPs, and proof\-of\-concepts, as needed.
* Collaborates with enterprise architects, application owners, PMO, and vendors to align solutions to business capabilities, value streams, and governance.
* Establishes and enforces architecture governance including reference architectures, design standards, and solution scorecards; ensure compliance with regulatory and SOX controls.
* Integrates SAP solutions with enterprise and third\-party systems (e.g., CX/Service Cloud), Customer facing websites, mobile apps and etc; define APIs and interfaces (IDoc/ALE, OData, RFC) following best practices.
* Mentors internal and external architects and engineers; promotes continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across agile teams. Translates business requirements into technical specifications and oversee successful solution delivery in partnership with IT teams and vendors.
* Performs system architecture assessments, performance reviews, and troubleshooting to resolve complex issues and maintain optimal performance.
* Ensures all solutions adhere to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and SAP best practices across implementations.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field and a minimum of 10 years of SAP experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* Relevant experience includes a deep expertise in utilities processes and IS\-U modules (Device Management, Billing, FI\-CA, IDEX).
* Hands\-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (at least one full\-cycle implementation), BW/4HANA, SAP BTP, Fiori, and ABAP, Data Lake, Could Technologies, CX \& Customer facing integrations.
* Proficiency with integration platforms and tools (SAP CPI/Integration Suite, PI/PO), and core integration technologies (IDoc/ALE, OData, RFC).
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture concepts, solution governance, and architecture documentation/road mapping.
* Knowledge of SAP Basis, security, and system administration; familiarity with SOX and relevant regulatory requirements. Experience optimizing performance, conducting assessments, and troubleshooting complex SAP landscapes in large enterprises. Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks.
* SAP certifications preferred (e.g. SAP certified Technology Associate, Solution Architecture).
* Extensive experience in design, implementation and support of SAP solution within large organization.
* Strong domain knowledge and good understanding on Meter\-to\-Cash processes, SAP IS\-U, Service Cloud and other Customer experience (CX) products.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s Degree in a related field.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills; ability to work across business and IT teams.
* Ability to work with management team counterparts to meet priorities and deadlines and resolve issues.
* Deep understanding of the utility business processes, regulatory requirements and the Intricacies of SAP technologies tailored for the utility Industry.


**Competencies**
* Growth \& Continuous Improvement
* Initiative \& Change
* Focused on Results
* Customer Centric (internal and/or External)
* Communication
* Collaboration
* Leadership (people managers/leaders)


**Benefits**
* Award winning student loan debt repayment program
* 12% 401(k) Match
* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits \- including medical, dental, vision and variety of well\-being programs
* Tuition Assistance

jobs.title: Vended Application Lead Consultant
jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**


The Vended Application Lead Consultant typically provides expertise across all major functions in their area(s) of the business and delivers product features utilizing vended software, particularly ERP applications, by applying knowledge of the application’s functionality and client business processes. The role creates technical and process designs and configures vendor software for new or existing complex enterprise\-wide and business\-unit applications and maintenance efforts. The Lead Consultant is also aware of vendor feature roadmaps and understands how to navigate support processes and developer groups to gain insight and influence future direction.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop overall product planning by contributing to/creating stories for complex features in areas of responsibility, including guiding the story development for other team members who may be learning.
* Organize, lead and finalize feature review sessions for complex business issues/requirements and document resulting decisions; provide coaching to newer team members on their features and delivery.
* Create the functional design, leveraging moderate technical skills, to address complex business processes or issues or to address the requirements of a set of product features.
* Configure or develop within vendor software; review and verify operation of new vendor release features. Leverage vendor defect resolution procedures and support tools to resolve issues.
* Provide training for other team members and users; assist in developing team bench strength.
* Use knowledge of integrated requirements to evaluate proposed software products in line with strategic corporate and vendor direction.
* Support the planning, conduct, and review of module and integration testing for all but the most complex projects.
* Manage the issues and blockers for assigned features and product stories.
* In partnership with the business groups and technical teams, provide knowledge and support for resolving technology issues in multiple areas of the business; acknowledged as a subject matter expert in multiple processes and applications.

### **Experience**

* 5 or more years of experience (Preferred)

### **Supervisory Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Order to Cash Platform (SAP BRIM)
jobs.description:
**Principal Product Manager Order to Cash Platform (SAP BRIM)**
**Location:** 
 San Jose, CA
   

  

**Our Company**
 Adobe is changing the world through digital experiences. We empower everyone \- from emerging artists to global brands \- to create and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We are passionate about building innovative products that transform how businesses engage with their customers.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Adobe is seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and modernization of our Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) platform powered by SAP BRIM. This highly visible role is responsible for defining the future of Adobe's monetization platform, supporting both B2B and B2C business models across subscriptions, usage\-based offerings, digital commerce, and enterprise licensing.
   

  

 As a Principal Product Manager, you will own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for critical Order to Cash (OTC) capabilities. You will partner closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Legal, and Tax teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities that support Adobe's evolving business needs.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines deep O2C domain expertise with strong Product Management fundamentals and SAP BRIM experience. You have successfully owned enterprise platform strategy, prioritized roadmap investments, driven measurable business outcomes, and influenced senior stakeholders in complex cross\-functional environments.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You are a product leader who thinks beyond system implementation and focuses on solving business problems through scalable platform capabilities.
   

  

 You have experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for enterprise platforms and understand how monetization, billing, revenue management, and financial processes work together to support business growth.
   

  

 You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on technical tradeoffs, collaborating with business stakeholders on priorities, and influencing executive leaders through data\-driven recommendations and clear product strategy.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Product Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define and own the multi\-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Adobe's O2C platform.
* Identify opportunities to improve scalability, operational efficiency, compliance, and customer experience across the monetization ecosystem.
* Prioritize platform investments based on business value, customer impact, operational needs, and technical feasibility.
* Influence executive stakeholders and partner with business leaders to align roadmap priorities with Adobe's strategic objectives.
* Establish success metrics, KPIs, and outcome\-based measures to evaluate product investments and platform performance.


**Product Management \& Execution**
* Own product requirements, backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, and delivery for key OTC capabilities.
* Translate complex business needs into clear product requirements, epics, user stories, and product decisions.
* Drive product discovery, solution evaluation, and business case development for strategic initiatives.
* Make prioritization decisions by balancing business value, customer needs, technical complexity, and operational impact.
* Partner closely with engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle to ensure successful execution and delivery.


**OTC Transformation**
* Lead product strategy and cross\-functional execution for strategic OTC transformation initiatives.
* Drive modernization efforts that support Adobe's evolving monetization models and operational requirements.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering teams to define future\-state platform capabilities and scalable solution approaches.
* Support ERP modernization initiatives, including SAP S/4HANA and SAP RISE transformations, ensuring alignment with Adobe's OTC strategy.
* Ensure solutions support subscriptions, recurring revenue, usage\-based billing, digital commerce, and enterprise licensing business models.


**SAP BRIM Product Ownership**
 Provide product leadership across SAP BRIM capabilities including:
   

  

* Subscription Order Management (SOM)
* Convergent Charging (CC)
* Convergent Invoicing (CI)
* Financial Contract Accounting (FICA)
* Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)
* SAP S/4HANA integrations


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Legal, Tax, Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture teams to define and deliver business capabilities.
* Influence and align stakeholders across multiple organizations and leadership levels.
* Communicate product strategy, roadmap priorities, tradeoffs, and outcomes to senior leaders and cross\-functional partners.
* Build consensus across competing priorities while maintaining focus on long\-term platform objectives and business outcomes.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in Product Management, Enterprise Platforms, Business Systems, OTC, Billing, Revenue Management, or related domains.
* 5\+ years of Product Management experience with ownership of product strategy, roadmap, and delivery.
* Experience owning the strategy and roadmap for enterprise, OTC, billing, revenue management, or monetization platforms.
* Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and business outcomes for enterprise business platforms.
* Proven track record of making product investment decisions and prioritization tradeoffs across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Experience serving as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or Platform Product Leader \- not solely as a SAP BRIM functional lead, implementation consultant, solution architect, systems analyst, or program manager.
* At least one end\-to\-end SAP BRIM implementation

jobs.title: SAP S/4 HANA BRIM Application Expert
jobs.description:
**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**
-----------------------


**Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service\-to\-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post\-go\-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**
---------------------------------


* Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested \& deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
* Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects \& leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance \& product management workstreams.
* Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
* Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI\-CA (Contract Accounting).
* Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
* Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go\-live and hyper care activities.
* Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.

**SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Essential:**

* Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 5 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
* Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs \& support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI\-CA.
* Hands\-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end\-to\-end billing cycles.
* Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations \& technology.
* Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
* Strong communication skills in English, self\-driven and motivated.
* Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline

**Desirable:**


* SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
* Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
* Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud\-based BRIM extensions.
* Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**

* Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
* Health and Safety accountability statements.
* Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.
